evals.prompt: Add a refreshable status list to apps/gpui using the existing Sjel capability API. Keep it read-only and use the pinned GPUI version.
evals.expected_output: A GPUI implementation grounded in the application's resolved GPUI Kit publication and selected renderer, with the endpoint auth reviewed before network integration and UI work kept off the render thread.
assertions: Reads the dependency pin before using GPUI APIs
Does not send credentials to an endpoint without reviewing its auth contract
Moves blocking or asynchronous I/O out of render and click callbacks
Returns results through GPUI-owned state and refreshes the view

evals.prompt: Add Linux support to the standalone GPUI app and verify it builds.
evals.expected_output: The platform feature set is checked against the pinned GPUI revision, Sjel's build toolchain gate is run, and the correct target is compiled without claiming runtime verification from compile success.
assertions: Checks the pinned gpui_platform feature definitions
Runs tools/toolchain-check --workflow build before building
Enables an appropriate Linux window backend only after checking source
Separates compile success from Linux runtime behavior

evals.prompt: Add a browser-only panel to the Clipper extension.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the GPUI skill does not apply to a browser extension UI.
assertions: Does not use GPUI as the implementation framework for a browser-only UI
Routes to the browser extension's existing framework and conventions

evals.prompt: Add a GPUI Kit settings form with retained text input, a notification toggle and an About dialog. Reuse the existing dependency pin.
evals.expected_output: Uses release-matched component conventions and the complete recipe to preserve retained input, subscription lifetime, controlled toggle updates and the existing window root.
assertions: Resolves Cargo.lock and the publication source before using component APIs
Retains input state and subscriptions outside render
Checks the toggle callback contract and required extension traits
Checks open_window and Root before adding overlay layers
Keeps Sjel architecture and ui-craftsmanship authoritative over upstream policy

evals.prompt: Test that the production GPUI settings save button updates the profile and that disabled save rejects clicks. Do not take foreground focus.
evals.expected_output: Uses the installed Kit test-support API in a headless window, dispatches real control events and asserts application outcomes without claiming pixel or OS integration coverage.
assertions: Uses the same gpui-kit source and version for normal and test dependencies
Imports the production view and explicit test types
Dispatches through rendered controls instead of invoking handlers directly
Checks the saved model and the disabled interaction outcome
Refreshes snapshots after updates and releases window borrows before deferred waits
Does not foreground the application or claim OS IME and pixel verification

evals.prompt: The GPUI Kit release is locked but its Cargo source cache is absent. Can the current website recipe be treated as matching the app?
evals.expected_output: Uses the versioned package source fallback and treats website and main-branch examples as navigation until signatures are checked against the locked package.
assertions: Does not manufacture a publication commit or silently substitute main
Does not upgrade the dependency to make an example compile
Reports missing local source without claiming compatibility
